shared_core.change_requirement: general defect with cross-case or data-free evidence and a superseding freeze

case_inputs.requirement: source provenance and uncertainty; no tactical outcome forcing

measurement_model.requirement: identified from source audits, overlaps, or external validation rather than simulator fit

estimated_nuisance.requirement: training data only with partial pooling and declared transport prior

forbidden: changing a split after viewing fit
adding a mechanism because one case fits better
using violence as a territorial-control proxy
silently relabeling all anti-government violence as the focal insurgent
conditioning tactical decisions on future outcomes
